newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers to offer $165 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers to offer $165 mln of notes.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co said Wednesay it intends to offer $165 million of senior subordinated notes, due 2007.

The offering will be made by means of a memorandum to qualified institutional buyers, and the securities will have certain registration rights. Proceeds will be used to repay amounts outstanding under the company's revolving credit facility, said the company.

The notes offered have not been and will not be registered under the Securities Act of 1933, said the company, and may not be offered or sold in the U.S. absent registration or an applicable exemption from registration requirements.
Cross Timbers is engaged in the acquisition, exploitation and development of producing oil and gas properties concentrated in Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas, New Mexico and Wyoming.
